say:1:1536145001:1.text: Last one was over a decade ago... and there was no winner.
say:1:1536145001:1.source_cn: 上次猎血节都是十几年前了……那次没人获胜。
say:1:1536145001:1.male: Last one was over a decade ago... and there was no winner.
say:1:1536145001:1.female: Last one was over a decade ago... and there was no winner.

say:2:1536145002:1.text: I was still young back then. Strong enough to join the tryout, but not strong enough to pass.
say:2:1536145002:1.source_cn: 那次举办时，我尚且年轻，还有力气参加选拔，只可惜没有通过。
say:2:1536145002:1.male: I was still young back then. Strong enough to join the tryout, but not strong enough to pass.
say:2:1536145002:1.female: I was still young back then. Strong enough to join the tryout, but not strong enough to pass.

say:3:1536145003:1.text: Time slips by. I got old before I knew it...
say:3:1536145003:1.source_cn: 唉，不知不觉，我已经这么老了……
say:3:1536145003:1.male: Time slips by. I got old before I knew it...
say:3:1536145003:1.female: Time slips by. I got old before I knew it...
